question: What in Malie’s export draft should change how Placarr treats Malie / Pokémon cards?
verdict: Useful as interchange ontology + foil taxonomy lessons; not a WebGL/shader source. We already bootstrap from databases/; export JSON is unused for product ingest.

lessonsApplied.lesson: Export foil.type SCREAMING_SNAKE ≠ Live PascalCase (pokebox trap)
lessonsApplied.action: malieFoilTaxonomy.ts maps ACE_FOIL→AceFoil, SV_HOLO→SvHolo, …; databases path already stores Live names

lessonsApplied.lesson: RAINBOW foil layer ≠ Rainbow Rare (SV = mainly Pokéball/Masterball reverse)
lessonsApplied.action: Encoded in malieFoilTaxonomy + tests; do not map rarity UI from foil.type alone

lessonsApplied.lesson: foil.mask export is HOLO|REVERSE|ETCHED|STAMPED — coarser than Live CastAndCure / laminates
lessonsApplied.action: Map export masks for future export ingest; keep Live masks for WebGL/CSS remaps

lessonsApplied.lesson: One language + one foil variant = one card object
lessonsApplied.action: Already our model (bundle_stem + variant std/ph/op); keep
Aligned with Placarr data-first; no change

lessonsApplied.lesson: BCP-47 langs (en-US, fr-FR, es-419, pt-BR); es-419 out of Live CDN for us
lessonsApplied.action: Documented; la/es-419 stay skipped until CDN ships

lessonsApplied.lesson: name_fr column is misnamed (holds LocalizedCardName for non-FR DBs)
lessonsApplied.action: Debt kept — consumers must join on lang; rename needs migration
